title: Odd electron count shortcut
statement:
Which isolated species is guaranteed to be paramagnetic by total electron count alone?

[_]{a}

explanations: Magnesium has 12 electrons and this ion has 11.
This has an even count of 10.
This has a closed shell of 10.
This also has a closed shell of 10.

hints: Count neutral electrons from the atomic number.
Odd totals cannot be fully paired.
solution: Count neutral electrons from the atomic number. Subtract a positive charge. Odd totals cannot be fully paired. Magnesium has 12 electrons and this ion has 11.
